note: Hand-authored registry of the road signs the question bank references. `symbol` drives 03_draw_signs.py; `sourceIds` are the CSV rows that describe this sign in words and are rewritten to the official stem. Names come from the keyed answers; meanings are plain-language and ours.

signs.name: Stop
signs.meaning: Stop completely at the line, then move on only when it is safe.

signs.name: Give way
signs.meaning: Slow down and give way to traffic on the road ahead; stop if you need to.

signs.name: No entry
signs.meaning: Do not enter this road from here.

signs.name: One way
signs.meaning: Traffic moves only in the direction of the arrow.

signs.name: Vehicles prohibited in both directions
signs.meaning: No vehicle may enter from either direction.

signs.name: Right turn prohibited
signs.meaning: You must not turn right here.

signs.name: U-turn prohibited
signs.meaning: You must not make a U-turn here.

signs.name: All motor vehicles prohibited
signs.meaning: Motor vehicles of every kind are not allowed beyond this point.

signs.name: Overtaking prohibited
signs.meaning: Do not overtake another vehicle on this stretch of road.

signs.name: Horn prohibited
signs.meaning: Do not sound your horn here, usually near a hospital or school.

signs.name: Pedestrians prohibited
signs.meaning: Pedestrians must not use this road.

signs.name: Cycles prohibited
signs.meaning: Bicycles are not allowed on this road.

signs.name: Trucks prohibited
signs.meaning: Lorries and heavy goods vehicles are not allowed.

signs.name: No parking
signs.meaning: You may stop briefly to set down or pick up, but you must not park here.

signs.name: No stopping or standing
signs.meaning: Do not stop or stand here at all, even briefly.

signs.name: End of all restrictions
signs.meaning: Every earlier restriction, such as a speed or overtaking limit, ends here.

signs.name: Speed limit
signs.meaning: Do not drive faster than the speed shown, in km/h.

signs.name: Width limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles wider than the figure shown may not enter.

signs.name: Height limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles taller than the figure shown may not enter.

signs.name: Axle load limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles with an axle load above the figure shown may not enter.

signs.name: Length limit
signs.meaning: Vehicles longer than the figure shown may not enter.

signs.name: Compulsory keep left
signs.meaning: You must keep to the left of the island or obstruction ahead.

signs.name: Compulsory ahead only
signs.meaning: You must go straight ahead; turning is not allowed.

signs.name: Compulsory turn left ahead
signs.meaning: You must turn left at the junction ahead.

signs.name: Compulsory turn right
signs.meaning: You must turn right.

signs.name: Compulsory ahead or turn left
signs.meaning: You may go straight ahead or turn left, but not right.

signs.name: Compulsory ahead or turn right
signs.meaning: You may go straight ahead or turn right, but not left.

signs.name: Compulsory sound horn
signs.meaning: Sound your horn here, typically before a blind bend.

signs.name: Compulsory cycle track
signs.meaning: Cyclists must use the cycle track; other vehicles may not use it.

signs.name: Cycle crossing ahead
signs.meaning: Cyclists may be crossing the road ahead; slow down.

signs.name: Right hand curve
signs.meaning: The road bends to the right ahead; slow down.

signs.name: Left hand curve
signs.meaning: The road bends to the left ahead; slow down.

signs.name: Right hair pin bend
signs.meaning: A very sharp bend to the right ahead; slow right down.

signs.name: Left hair pin bend
signs.meaning: A very sharp bend to the left ahead; slow right down.

signs.name: Right reverse bend
signs.meaning: An S-bend ahead, turning first to the right and then to the left.

signs.name: Steep ascent
signs.meaning: A steep uphill stretch ahead; change to a lower gear.

signs.name: Steep descent
signs.meaning: A steep downhill stretch ahead; use a lower gear and brake gently.

signs.name: Narrow road ahead
signs.meaning: The road narrows ahead; slow down and be ready to give way.

signs.name: Road widens ahead
signs.meaning: The road becomes wider ahead.

signs.name: Narrow bridge ahead
signs.meaning: A narrow bridge ahead; be ready to wait for oncoming traffic.

signs.name: Slippery road
signs.meaning: The surface ahead may be slippery; slow down and avoid sudden braking.

signs.name: Loose gravel
signs.meaning: Loose stones ahead may be thrown up by wheels; slow down.

signs.name: Pedestrian crossing ahead
signs.meaning: A pedestrian crossing ahead; be ready to stop.

signs.name: School ahead
signs.meaning: A school ahead; drive slowly and watch for children.

signs.name: Men at work
signs.meaning: Road work ahead; slow down and follow any instructions.

signs.name: Falling rocks
signs.meaning: Rocks may fall onto the road here; do not stop.

signs.name: Cross road ahead
signs.meaning: A crossroads ahead; watch for traffic from both sides.

signs.name: Gap in median
signs.meaning: A gap in the central divider ahead, where vehicles may cross or turn.

signs.name: Side road right
signs.meaning: A minor road joins from the right ahead.

signs.name: Side road left
signs.meaning: A minor road joins from the left ahead.

signs.name: Roundabout ahead
signs.meaning: A roundabout ahead; give way to traffic already on it.

signs.name: Major road ahead
signs.meaning: You are approaching a major road; be ready to give way.

signs.name: Y-intersection
signs.meaning: The road forks ahead.

signs.name: Staggered intersection
signs.meaning: Two side roads join ahead, one shortly after the other.

signs.name: Hump or rough road ahead
signs.meaning: A hump or rough surface ahead; slow down.

signs.name: Barrier ahead
signs.meaning: A barrier or gate across the road ahead.

signs.name: Cattle
signs.meaning: Cattle may be on the road ahead; slow down.

signs.name: Guarded level crossing
signs.meaning: A railway crossing with gates ahead; stop if the gates are closing.

signs.name: Unguarded level crossing
signs.meaning: A railway crossing without gates ahead; stop, look and listen before crossing.

signs.name: Petrol pump
signs.meaning: A petrol pump is ahead.

signs.name: Eating place
signs.meaning: A restaurant or eating place is ahead.

signs.name: Resting place
signs.meaning: A resting place or lodging is ahead.

signs.name: First aid post
signs.meaning: A first-aid post is ahead.

signs.name: Hospital
signs.meaning: A hospital is ahead; drive quietly and do not sound the horn.

signs.name: No through road
signs.meaning: This road has no exit at the far end.

signs.name: No through side road
signs.meaning: The side road ahead has no exit.

signs.name: Park this side
signs.meaning: Parking is allowed on this side of the road.

signs.name: Parking lot for scooters and motorcycles
signs.meaning: A parking place for scooters and motorcycles.
